findings.current: Unfortunately, Schumacher had been ambushed right at the end of that moment. But when he opened his eyes again, he would probably be stronger than before.
findings.defect: The draft says Schumacher reached the end of the transcendent moment before being ambushed, while the source explicitly says he was ambushed before he could reach its end.
findings.rationale: 다다르지 못하고 means he failed to reach the end, not that the ambush occurred at the end.
findings.replacement: Unfortunately, Schumacher had been ambushed before he could reach the end of that moment, but when he opened his eyes again, he would probably be stronger than before.
findings.source: 안타깝게도 슈마허는 그 순간의 끝자락에 다다르지 못하고 기습당했지만, 아마 다시 눈을 떴을 때는 한층 강해져 있을 것이다.

findings.current: I crooked a finger at the enormous monster that was eyeing me warily as it backed away.
findings.defect: The draft turns the monster's hesitation into a physical retreat before it has begun backing away in the scene.
findings.rationale: 주춤거리며 indicates hesitating or flinching here; the Minotaur Lord only retreats later, matching Jin's advance.
findings.replacement: I crooked a finger at the enormous monster glaring at me, its movements hesitant.
findings.source: 나는 주춤거리며 이쪽을 노려보는 거대한 괴물을 향해 손가락을 까딱거렸다.

findings.defect: The rendering preserves the place-name but leaves English readers without the livestock-and-meat-market context that makes Jin's self-introduction to a Minotaur comic.
findings.rationale: The source's joke depends on Majang-dong's association with slaughtering and selling livestock, which is not apparent from the untranslated place-name alone.
findings.replacement:
“The Majang-dong Spearman.[^1]”

[^1]: Majang-dong is a Seoul district known for its livestock and meat markets.

findings.defect: “Take it” is not idiomatic English for ordering troops into formation.
findings.rationale: 갖춰 is a clipped command to form up, not to take possession of something.

findings.current: Ares and more than two hundred Hunters from the Peace Guild had come with us as well. They had not played much of a role in the battle against Leviathan, but they were the elite of the elite, and they finished preparing to face the enemy without a trace of hesitation.
findings.defect: The draft treats Ares as a separate individual or entity alongside more than two hundred Peace Guild Hunters. The source refers collectively to more than two hundred Hunters from the Ares Guild and Peace Guild.
findings.rationale: 아레스와 평화 길드의 헌터 이백여 명 coordinates the two Guilds as the affiliations of the roughly two hundred Hunters; 아레스 is the established Ares Guild.
findings.replacement: More than two hundred Hunters from the Ares Guild and Peace Guild had come with us as well. Though they had not played much of a role in the battle against Leviathan, they were the elite of the elite and prepared to face the enemy without the slightest hesitation.
findings.source: 레비아탄과의 전투에서는 별다른 활약을 하지 못한 아레스와 평화 길드의 헌터 이백여 명도 함께였고, 정예 중의 정예인 그들은 한 치의 흔들림도 없이 적들을 맞이할 준비를 끝마쳤다.

findings.current: Taking the thunderous roar of the people as its signal, I kicked off the ground with all my strength.
findings.defect: The possessive “its” shifts the signal to the preceding fire dragon, whereas Jin is the one who uses the crowd's roar as his signal to charge.
findings.rationale: 나는 is the subject of both using the shout as a signal and kicking off the ground.
findings.replacement: Taking the crowd’s thunderous roar as my signal, I kicked off the ground with all my strength.
findings.source: 사람들이 내지르는 거대한 함성을 신호탄 삼아, 나는 힘차게 지면을 박찼다.

findings.current: The Minotaur blinked with the innocent expression of a docile yellow cow in some old scholar’s yard.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the specific comic image of Scholar Kim's yellow ox with a generic old scholar and changes his house into a yard.
findings.rationale: 김 진사 댁 누렁소 is a deliberately specific, rustic comparison; preserving Scholar Kim and his household retains the source image without adding details.
findings.replacement: The Minotaur blinked innocently, like the yellow ox at Scholar Kim’s house.
findings.source: 미노타우로스가 김 진사 댁 누렁소처럼 순박하게 눈을 깜빡인다.

findings.current: “You may have come however the fuck you pleased, but you don’t get to leave that way.”
findings.defect: “Leave that way” suggests a restriction on the manner of departure, while the source says that leaving is no longer the Minotaur Lord's decision.
findings.rationale: 갈 때는 아니지 contrasts arriving at will with being unable to depart at will; the restriction concerns permission and control, not the method of leaving.
findings.replacement: “You came here however the fuck you pleased, but leaving isn’t up to you.”
findings.source: “올 때는 좆대로 왔어도, 갈 때는 아니지.”

summary: The draft contains two altered actions, a guild-and-quantity misreading, a shifted action cue, and several localized terminology or cultural-reference issues.
